g.text: State = object location. All three placement actions are available in every state.

g.text: Each panel is the same three states under a different action. Arrow labels are total one-step probabilities.

g.text: 90%: keep the current location. 10%: attempt placement — 80% intended location, 10% each other location.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526674

g.text: A command to the current location stays there with probability 98%; a command elsewhere stays put with probability 91%.
